name: Sardaukar Legion
text:
As an additional cost to play this unit, defeat a friendly Spice token.
[When Played:] Search the top 10 cards of your deck for any number of [{Sardaukar}] units and reveal them. You may defeat up to 3 friendly Spice tokens. Play any number of the revealed units with a combined cost of 2 or less for each Spice token defeated this way, for free, ignoring their additional costs.
